air-conditioning.title: Air Conditioning Installation & Repairs Perth | Ellis
air-conditioning.h1: Air Conditioning Installation & Repairs in Perth
air-conditioning.description: Discuss split or ducted air conditioning, weak airflow, leaks or replacement with Ellis Perth. An assessment confirms the system needs, work scope and quote.
qa: Can Ellis help with an air conditioner that is not cooling properly?

Tell Ellis which rooms are affected, the system type and any weak airflow, unusual noise or leaks. An appropriately qualified assessment can establish the cause and whether servicing, repair or replacement is suitable.
What information helps with a new air conditioning installation?

Share the property type, rooms you want to heat or cool and any existing system details. The assessment considers room layout, equipment location and access before confirming the installation scope and quote.
Who should assess electrical or refrigerant work on an air conditioner?

Electrical connections and refrigerant work need appropriately qualified trades and relevant licences where required. Tell Ellis the symptoms to arrange an assessment. Keep clear of a unit that is smoking, sparking or visibly damaged; use emergency services for immediate danger.

electricians.title: Electrical Repairs & Electrician Services Perth | Ellis
electricians.h1: Electrical Repairs & Electrician Services in Perth
electricians.description: Tell Ellis Perth about faulty lights, power points, tripping circuits or renovation electrical work. Confirm the assessment, qualified work scope and quote.
qa: Who should replace a power point or install a new light?

Fixed electrical work requires an appropriately licensed electrician where required. Tell Ellis the fitting or power point location and the change you want so the electrical assessment can confirm the work scope.
What should I tell Ellis about a circuit that keeps tripping?

Describe what stopped working, when the problem began and the rooms or fittings involved. An appropriately qualified assessment can investigate the fault. Keep clear of exposed wires, smoke, sparks or wet electrical equipment; use emergency services for immediate danger.
Can electrical work be assessed as part of a renovation?

Share the proposed layout, lighting, power point and appliance requirements with Ellis. The assessment can review switchboard and safety-switch needs and confirm the electrical scope before work is agreed.

insulation.title: Ceiling, Wall & Underfloor Insulation Perth | Ellis
insulation.description: Discuss ceiling, wall or underfloor insulation with Ellis Perth. Coverage, condition, access and installation requirements are assessed before a scope and quote.
qa: Can missing ceiling insulation be assessed before an upgrade?

Yes. Tell Ellis which area feels uncomfortable and what you know about the existing insulation. An assessment checks accessible coverage and condition before confirming whether gaps or a wider upgrade need attention.
What details are useful for wall or underfloor insulation?

Share the construction type, area to be insulated and any known access limits. Moisture, pest or existing-insulation concerns help identify what needs assessment before a suitable material and installation scope are agreed.
Do I need to enter the roof space before contacting Ellis?

No. Describe the target area and any access information you already have. Roof spaces can contain electrical, heat, asbestos and access hazards; inspection and installation should be assessed by appropriately qualified people.

plumbers.title: Plumbing Repairs & Plumber Services Perth | Ellis
plumbers.h1: Plumbing Repairs & Plumber Services in Perth
plumbers.description: Discuss leaking taps, toilets, blocked fixtures or pipework with Ellis Perth. An appropriately qualified assessment confirms the plumbing repair scope and quote.
qa: Who should assess a leaking tap or pipe?

Tell Ellis where the leak appears, when it started and any visible damage. Plumbing work may need an appropriately licensed plumber. A qualified assessment confirms the cause and suitable repair or replacement scope.
Can a blocked sink, toilet or drain be assessed?

Describe the affected fixtures and whether there is overflow. The assessment can establish the blockage and suitable clearing work. Keep clear of contaminated overflow and any electrical equipment affected by water.
Is a shower leak always a plumbing repair?

A shower leak may involve a fixture, pipework or the wet-area construction. Tell Ellis where water appears and whether earlier repairs changed it. An appropriately qualified assessment is needed before deciding on plumbing, resealing or a wider wet-area repair.

gas-fitters.title: Gas Fitting & Gas Appliance Connections Perth | Ellis
gas-fitters.h1: Gas Fitting & Gas Appliance Work in Perth
gas-fitters.description: Discuss non-emergency gas appliance connections, replacements or pipework with Ellis Perth. A qualified assessment confirms compatibility, scope and quote.
qa: What information helps with a gas appliance replacement?

For non-emergency work, tell Ellis the appliance type, brand, model and location. An appropriately qualified assessment checks compatibility and the connection, replacement or disconnection scope before a quote is confirmed.
Can gas pipework be assessed when changing an appliance location?

Share the proposed appliance location and any recent work with Ellis. Gas pipework changes require an appropriately licensed gas fitter where required, with testing and work confirmed within the assessed scope.
Should I book a routine assessment if I suspect a gas leak?

A suspected gas leak needs an urgent safety response. Avoid flames and electrical switching, leave the area and contact the gas emergency service. Call emergency services for immediate danger. Routine enquiries with Ellis are for non-emergency work.

cladding.title: Cladding Repairs & Replacement Perth | Ellis
cladding.description: Discuss loose, damaged or weathered cladding with Ellis Perth. Wall condition, material, junctions and access are assessed before repairs or replacement are quoted.
qa: Can damaged cladding boards or panels be replaced individually?

Localised replacement may be suitable if compatible material is available and the surrounding wall is sound. Tell Ellis which wall is affected and the material type if known. The assessment confirms the repair area and finish.
What should be checked when cladding leaks near a window or roof?

The cladding, openings and nearby flashings need assessment together. Tell Ellis where moisture appears and when it occurs so the inspection can consider the junctions before a repair scope is agreed.
Should old cladding be disturbed before an assessment?

Leave suspect material undisturbed. Older cladding may contain hazardous materials, and work at height needs safe access. Share the building age and material details you already know with Ellis; safely taken existing photos are optional.

gutter-services.title: Gutter Cleaning, Repairs & Replacement Perth | Ellis
gutter-services.h1: Gutter Cleaning, Repairs & Replacement in Perth
gutter-services.description: Discuss blocked, overflowing, leaking or rusted gutters with Ellis Perth. Gutters, downpipes and safe access are assessed before cleaning or repairs are quoted.
qa: Why do my gutters still overflow after cleaning?

Leaves are only one possible cause. Blocked outlets, downpipe problems, gutter falls or damaged sections may also need attention. Tell Ellis where overflow occurs and whether it happens in light or heavy rain so the assessment can check the drainage.
Can leaking or sagging gutters be repaired instead of replaced?

Localised leaking joins, loose brackets or damaged sections may suit a repair. Widespread deterioration may need replacement. Ellis assesses the gutters and downpipes before confirming the work scope and quote.
What do you need to assess gutter cleaning on a single-storey home?

Tell Ellis the building height, roof type and any known access limits. Safe access must be assessed even on a single-storey home. Existing photos are optional; there is no need to climb onto the roof to make an enquiry.

house-painters.title: Interior & Exterior House Painting Perth | Ellis
house-painters.h1: Interior & Exterior House Painting in Perth
house-painters.description: Discuss room repainting, exterior painting or trim touch-ups with Ellis Perth. Surface preparation, coating compatibility and finish are assessed before a quote.
qa: Can a small paint repair match the rest of the wall?

The existing colour, sheen, coating condition and light can affect the appearance of a touch-up. Tell Ellis which area needs painting and any paint details you have. The assessment confirms whether a local repair or wider repaint is suitable.
Can walls, ceilings, doors and trims be included in one painting enquiry?
List the rooms and surfaces you want painted, along with your colour and finish preferences. Ellis assesses surface preparation and coating compatibility before confirming the agreed areas and quote.
What happens if exterior paint is peeling or the surface is damp?

The surface and moisture concerns need assessment before preparation or coating. Older paint may contain lead, and work at height needs suitable controls. Tell Ellis the condition and any previous coating or moisture problems.

pavers.title: Paving Installation & Repairs Perth | Ellis
pavers.description: Discuss new paths, outdoor paving or uneven pavers with Ellis Perth. The base, levels and drainage are assessed before preparation, laying or repair is quoted.
qa: Can sunken or lifted pavers be repaired without replacing the whole area?

Localised lifting and relaying may be suitable after the cause is assessed. Tell Ellis where the paving is uneven and any known root, drainage or settlement issues. The assessment confirms the base repairs and paving scope.
What should I share when planning a new paved path or outdoor area?

Tell Ellis how the area will be used, your paver preference and any material-access limits. Existing measurements are helpful but optional. Site levels, drainage and the base need assessment before the layout and quote are confirmed.
Why does uneven paving need more than a surface repair?
Ground movement, roots or poor drainage can affect the base beneath the pavers. Assessing the cause helps define suitable preparation. Service locations also need checking before excavation.

roofing.title: Roofing & Roof Leak Repairs Perth | Ellis
roofing.description: Tell Ellis Perth about roof leaks, damaged tiles or sheets and flashing concerns. Safe access and the likely water-entry path are assessed before repairs are quoted.
qa: What should I tell Ellis about a roof leak?

Describe where internal staining or water appears, when it happens and any previous repairs. Share the roof material and building height if known. The assessment checks roof coverings, flashings and penetrations to identify the likely water-entry path.
Can damaged roof tiles or sheets be repaired locally?

Localised replacement may be suitable depending on the material and surrounding roof condition. An inspection is needed to confirm the affected components and whether a larger repair or replacement scope is required.
Do I need to climb onto the roof to photograph the damage?

No. Existing photos or images taken safely from ground level are optional. Roof access involves fall, fragile-surface and electrical hazards. Significant storm damage or live electrical hazards need an urgent specialist response.

renderers.title: Wall Rendering & Render Repairs Perth | Ellis
renderers.h1: Wall Rendering & Render Repairs in Perth
renderers.description: Discuss cracked, hollow or damaged wall render with Ellis Perth. The masonry, moisture conditions and finish are assessed before rendering or repairs are quoted.
qa: Can a small damaged area of render be repaired?

A localised repair may be suitable if the underlying masonry and surrounding render are sound. Tell Ellis the wall location, finish type and damage. The assessment confirms the repair area and suitable render system.
Why should damp or recurring render cracks be assessed first?

Damp, persistent cracking or hollow areas can indicate a moisture or substrate problem. Covering the surface alone may leave the cause unresolved. Tell Ellis about previous repairs and any changes in the cracks before resurfacing is considered.
Can repaired render match the existing wall texture?

The existing texture and finish need inspection before a matching approach can be agreed. Share the finish type, colour and age if known. The assessment confirms the wall area and expected finish; an exact match should not be assumed.
